artifacts:
CREATE TABLE artifacts (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	project_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	sandbox_id VARCHAR(64), 
	tool_execution_id VARCHAR(64), 
	conversation_id VARCHAR(64), 
	workspace_id VARCHAR(64), 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	category VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	size_bytes BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	object_key VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL, 
	url TEXT, 
	preview_url TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	source_tool VARCHAR(100), 
	source_path VARCHAR(500), 
	artifact_metadata JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(project_id) REFERENCES projects (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(workspace_id) REFERENCES workspaces (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_project_category ON artifacts (project_id, category)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_project_status ON artifacts (project_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_artifacts_workspace_status ON artifacts (workspace_id, status)
